summary: Iter12 regression on FieldCRM login/OTP flow. Verified backend request-otp/verify-otp/auth.me for Super Admin (9858558555/557725), Reviewer Bypass (9898989898/123456), and Tenant Admin demo (9000000001/123456). Confirmed /api/public/tenant-resolve works and doesn't 500. Frontend /login super admin flow and /t/demo tenant staff flow validated end-to-end including 10-digit phone strict enforcement and mock_otp hint display. The recurring 'Failed to send OTP' bug appears fully resolved on this fork.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not accept ?slug=demo query as hinted in the review request; it is host-based only (host / X-Forwarded-Host / Host header). Not blocking — returns 200 with tenant=null when host doesn't match. Consider adding slug fallback for testability.

issues: Recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic only; container sizing issue on some tiles.

action_items: (Optional) Support ?slug=<x> query fallback in /api/public/tenant-resolve for easier debugging.
(Optional) Fix Recharts container sizing warnings in tenant admin dashboard tiles (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3218 lines — recommend splitting by domain (auth, tenants, orders, etc.) for maintainability.
auth/me returns nested {user, tenant} but Pydantic response shape is loose (dict) — consider a typed response model.
Super admin uses `role: 'super_admin'` — no is_super_admin boolean is set on user object (frontend/tests must key off role); ensure this is documented.
test_credentials: Super Admin 9858558555/557725, Reviewer 9898989898/123456, Tenant Admin (demo) 9000000001/123456 — all working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP flow is stable. /api/auth/me is the profile endpoint (NOT /api/me/profile which is PATCH-only). Response shape: {user: {...}, tenant: {...}}. Super admin identified by user.role=='super_admin' (no is_super_admin flag). /api/public/tenant-resolve is host-based only; no slug query param support. Backend pytest test_login_regression_iter12.py (8 tests) can be reused for future regression.
rca of the issue: Previous 'Failed to send OTP' recurring bug was traced to backend crash-loops after ROOT_DOMAIN .env changes. On this fork backend is healthy (all OTP endpoints return 200 with correct mock_otp payloads) and Login.jsx 502 retry logic did not double-fire since first attempts already returned 200. No regression observed.
